message: 出動!!　流星クルセイダース

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Synn! Wake up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh…… Mnnn」

name: Synn
message: 「Ha――!? What happened to the Demons?」

name: Misa
message: 「While you were sleeping, Sakura-kun, this happened.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They were beaten black and blue~\s07」
They're lying collapsed in a pretty foolish way. Ah, I guess I was one of them too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, doing something so reckless!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ah, sorry. What matters is everyone is safe.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, Demons. Return to where you belong!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai…… wait a second.」
Even though it's a monster, its clear eyes looked as if they were brimming with tears, so I instinctively stopped her.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, you guys. Why did you do this?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn……-kun?」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I see.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait…… are you conversing with that thing?」

name: Synn
message: 「I have no idea what it's saying, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're saying they just couldn't help wanting to eat meat buns, damn it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, as expected of a non-human creature. You can understand each other's language.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even without asking, it's obvious, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see…… but if you want meat buns, you have to properly pay money for them.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Even if you say that……」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't have money, you have to endure it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're saying they couldn't endure it, which is why they did this.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just stealing!」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's a perfectly sound point, but... our opponent isn't a human, it's a demon...」

name: Synn
message: 「Demons can eat if they pay for it too, right?」

name: Kim-san
message: 「As long as they pay money, they are fine customers, yes!」
Kimura-san, the waitress at the Five-Star Restaurant, nods in agreement.

name: Synn
message: 「See? Got it?」
They're nodding.
While munching on meat buns.

name: Synn
message: 「Where's the money?」
Of course they don't have any.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, I'm sorry. The free voucher... I'll pay for the food... with this instead.」
I take the free voucher from Nanaka and hand it to Kimura-san.

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eee♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They slyly ate five servings. Finished off every bit.」

name: Misa
message: 「And with a completely blank expression, no less.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But look at those musical notes popping up. I'm sure they're in a great mood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't do something like this ever again, okay?」
Whether my words or feelings got through, the creatures quietly walked away.

name: Ria
message: 「W-Wait a minute, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, case closed.」

name: Ria
message: 「You have to drive the demons away!」

name: Synn
message: 「I did drive them away properly, didn't I?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, yes, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「I didn't know demon extermination could be done like this...」
To be honest, I wasn't keen on using dangerous methods like yesterday.
After all, I'm a demon myself. It sounds hard to believe, but intentionally driving out beings that might be my own kind hurts my conscience.

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Secretly expanding your influence to take over the Human World... That's brilliant!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, come on.」
If they don't learn their lesson and do something bad again, we'll just deal with it next time too.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is such a pity about the meat buns.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, there's always next time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, guys.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's fine. More importantly, you're taking convenience to an absurd level by wrapping it up so neatly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's with you? You want a compliment because you fought hard?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's not it at all! I just can't stand your attitude of taking all the blame on yourself. The meat bun issue was a unanimous decision by the Student Council. Got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Ria
message: 「Nobody's holding it against you. So don't beat yourself up over it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay.」
Even so, everyone had such high expectations for those meat buns...

name: Kim-san
message: 「Wait a moment, yes. Thanks for helping me out. Even without free coupon, I give you meat buns.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! Kimura-san is so generous!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, doing good deeds really pays off, doesn't it~?」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you very much.」
The special meat buns are handed out to each of them.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What about mine...?」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Aiya! So sorry, yes. All sold out now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here! Guess it can't be helped, so let's split mine in half.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just like the Vice President said, right? It was a decision made by all of us.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. Here, go ahead.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Just so you know, I haven't taken a bite yet.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... I'm sorry mine is on the smaller side, but...」
One after another, they share their portions with me.

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone... thank you!」
In the end, I end up eating roughly two people's worth of meat buns.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! This is top-tier meat bun quality!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, stop exaggerating. As if you can even tell the difference from frozen ones.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's packed full of everyone's warm feelings, so of course it tastes delicious.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hearing you say that makes me feel kind of embarrassed\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. If you think you've won over the organization with just this, you're dead wrong.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you, everyone.」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen to what I'm saying--!」

name: Misa
message: 「--Wait, oh no!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Vice President, are you leaving already?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I am. Well then, goodbye.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa~ Thanks for the meat bun~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, a phone call.」

name: Synn
message: 「Who is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's mine\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hurry up and answer it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello? Old man? I'm at the meat bun shop for Student Council activities.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is this really Student Council activities?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it's just an excuse.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave picking up and dropping off Milady to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you, Jiiya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, everyone. Have a good day♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A butler, huh? Amazing~」

name: Synn
message: 「It really is incredible. A woman butler, I mean.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*That's* what you're surprised about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't they usually men?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a prejudice, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like, wouldn't women be maids instead?」

name: Ria
message: 「Some of the helpers at my house are men, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no. Normally, people don't have *either* a butler or a maid.」
It really hits home all over again that Lolotte and Ria-senpai are rich young ladies, while the rest of us are just commoners.

name: Ria
message: 「I have things to take care of at school, so I'll say goodbye here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bye-bye, Ria-senpai.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please tell Helena-san that 'it was delicious.'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You sure are happy as long as anything tastes good.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep. Nothing brings greater happiness than eating for free.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you glad you became the Student Council President then?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just hope things keep going smoothly like this every day.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who knows?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, who knows. I have a hunch it won't be that simple.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yup. Student Council duties plus fighting Demons--there's no doubt we're gonna be busy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you glad you became the treasurer, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not really sure yet. But I don't dislike it. Plus, I still get to participate in my club.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but being suddenly told to transform and fight...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was actually pretty fun. Felt like going on some kind of amusement park ride.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not a game, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus, the outfit when I transformed--I don't own anything that cute, so I was really happy!」

name: Synn
message: 「It actually suited you surprisingly well.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, really? ...Thanks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait! 'Surprisingly'!? How rude!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, whoa, whoa, I was just being honest!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Says you! What about you, then?! Come on, transform already--take this, take this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop it, stooop~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait a second... when I transformed...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah!! Ahhhh~!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I completely forgot. You... um, well, you saw mine, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My transformation! You saw it, right?!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ah, no, well, that was... how should I put it, or rather...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I tried not to look! But it was totally beyond my control, I swear!」

name: Nanaka
message: *giggle*

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!? What's with you all of a sudden?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Per-ver-t\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I can't believe you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aw, you're turning all red. So cuuuute~」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tease me!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who cares about soba?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hands down, today's MVP is Ria-chan. Voluptuous chest, bountiful bust, ripe, luscious boobs...」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop it, Paqy! You're only looking at her chest!\s03」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, a brand-new legend... in the memorial of my heart.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, you brat!\s09」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mugh!」
